opening.argument: The presentation invites viewers to enter mining pools with an initial payment and says submitted tokens can generate OneCoins in a personal account. It encourages accumulation of the coins while presenting them as “this appreciating asset,” linking participation to the prospect of financial freedom. The structure also ties network growth and team building to exceptionally large compensation, including the claim of “20% in your network and match in bonuses with your entire team.” Although the presentation briefly acknowledges risk and describes recruiting as optional, it still asks viewers to build a team and frames participation as a route to substantial returns. Those qualifications do not remove the central paid mining and network based return opportunity.

citations.quote: When you decide to be part of the mining pools you can start as low as a hundred and thirty euros
by submitting these tokens, will be able to generate OneCoins to your own personal account.
You have the potential to earn 20% in your network and match in bonuses with your entire team.
It's not about the compensation plan. It's about this appreciating asset.
